title: Rule: no code you can't explain
why_it_matters: Unexplained code becomes a trap the day something breaks.
explanation: If you can't say what a block does, don't merge it. Ask for a simpler version, or learn the concept first. This rule slows you slightly now and saves hours later. It is also exactly what interviewers probe for.
try_it: Mark the parts of your project you couldn't explain, and study one.
